fact: BTW Media reports that Virtual Technologies & Solutions (VTS) runs the Virtix data centre in Ouagadougou, which offers colocation, cloud and hosting services; the article gives no opening date, so as_of is the article's published date.

BTW Media describes VTS's Virtix data centre in Ouagadougou, in service and offering colocation, as Tier III, with no certifying body named (an operator-profile claim); no date given, so as_of is the article's published date.

IKA Solution officially launched IKA Cloud in Ouagadougou on 31 July 2026, described by AIB as Burkina Faso's first 100% local data host: a data hosting centre in the country offering hosting to businesses, individuals, start-ups and institutions.

IKA Solution LTD launched IKA Cloud on 31 July 2026 in Ouagadougou, a data hosting centre in Burkina Faso built with technical support from Virtual Technology, selling web hosting, VPS, dedicated servers and server colocation to outside customers, and reporting 600+ domain names, 196+ web hosting accounts and 98% availability at launch.
